claim_text: Video captures NEET 2026 candidates sharing their joy after the results were declared on July 16, 2026.
ground_truth_notes: BOOM's official ClaimReview block: Claim as stated, Claimed By: BJP, Fact Check: False. This specific Instagram Reel (posted by @pw_vidyapeeth_up on 2026-05-07) is one of the source videos BOOM traced and embedded directly in their article as one of the videos recirculated to falsely suggest NEET 2026 result-day celebration; BOOM found the video predates the actual July 16, 2026 result declaration (the original May 3 exam was cancelled over a leak, re-held June 21, results declared July 16). Note: the ClaimReview covers the combined BJP post (two videos); this benchmark entry tests TruthLens against one specific, still-live source video from that post, not the BJP post itself (which is no longer live and only accessible via archive.is).

claim_text: Video shows a woman's masked identity being revealed amid misconduct/indecency at the Delhi CJP protest at Jantar Mantar.
ground_truth_notes: This is the exact Instagram Reel Alt News identifies as the source of the false claim: posted by Karni Sena leader Vishnu Rajput on 2026-07-26 (10,000+ likes), captioned as showing misconduct at the Delhi CJP protest. Alt News traced the video via reverse image search to FIFA World Cup 2026 celebration footage from Mexico (originally posted by Instagram account 'flowmexicanoofficial' on 2026-06-27, with a Spanish caption about a luchador mask), and to a second unrelated Instagram repost ('tunseaevents', 2026-07-05) referencing the World Cup. Straightforward miscaptioned/wrong-context video, cleanly FALSE rather than MIXED since the location and event are simply incorrect, not partially true.
